quarterly_data.signal: Dycom's fiscal 2027 first-quarter release (quarter ended May 2, 2026): contract revenues of $1,964.8 million versus $1,258.6 million (+56.1%), up 24.7% organically; Non-GAAP Adjusted EBITDA of $262.5 million (13.4% of contract revenues versus 11.9%); Non-GAAP Adjusted Diluted EPS of $4.42 versus $2.39. Communications contract revenues were $1,569.4 million (Adjusted EBITDA margin 12.3%), driven by expansion into additional geographies and fiber-to-the-home builds that ramped ahead of expectations; Building Systems contract revenues were $395.4 million (Adjusted EBITDA margin 17.7%).
quarterly_data.figure: Q1 FY2027 (quarter ended May 2, 2026) contract revenues $1,964.8 million (+56.1%, +24.7% organic); Adj. EBITDA $262.5 million (13.4%); Adj. EPS $4.42; Communications $1,569.4 million; Building Systems $395.4 million

quarterly_data.signal: Record total backlog of $11,906.0 million as of May 2, 2026 versus $8,127.1 million a year earlier (+46.5%), of which $6,397 million is expected in the next 12 months; Communications backlog $10,800 million ($5,376 million next 12 months) and Building Systems $1,106 million ($1,021 million). The Q1 2027 presentation shows a 2.2x book-to-bill and says customers are proactively extending contract durations to lock in Dycom's skilled workforce to meet long-term build goals.
quarterly_data.figure: total backlog $11,906.0 million (May 2, 2026) vs $8,127.1 million (+46.5%); next 12 months $6,397 million; Communications $10,800 million; Building Systems $1,106 million; book-to-bill 2.2x (Q1 2027)

quarterly_data.signal: Dycom raised its fiscal 2027 outlook (fiscal year ending January 30, 2027) to contract revenues of $7.38 billion to $7.65 billion, with Communications at $6.03 billion to $6.20 billion and Building Systems at $1.35 billion to $1.45 billion (Building Systems Adjusted EBITDA margin now expected in the high teens). For the second quarter ending August 1, 2026 it expected contract revenues of $1.94 billion to $2.01 billion, Non-GAAP Adjusted EBITDA of $284 million to $303 million and Non-GAAP Adjusted Diluted EPS of $4.40 to $4.82. The outlook excludes the pending National Technology Integrators acquisition.
quarterly_data.figure: FY2027 contract revenues $7.38 billion to $7.65 billion (Communications $6.03 billion to $6.20 billion; Building Systems $1.35 billion to $1.45 billion); Q2 revenue $1.94 billion to $2.01 billion, Adj. EBITDA $284 million to $303 million, Adj. EPS $4.40 to $4.82

quarterly_data.signal: Effective May 22, 2026 Dycom entered into a definitive agreement to acquire National Technology Integrators, a low-voltage engineering and construction firm specializing in inside-plant structured cabling, including within data centers, plus audio-visual and security systems; at closing it joins the Building Systems segment with an anticipated initial annual revenue run-rate of approximately $175 million and a 300+ skilled workforce, and Dycom says it lets the company support customers from the initial connection at the server racks through the networks connecting data centers.
